notes: Often combined with 'thấy' as 'ngửi thấy' to mean detecting a scent (literally 'smell and perceive'), whereas 'ngửi' alone can just mean sniffing at something.
Only used as an active verb (using one's nose). To say something smells good or has a scent, use 'thơm' (fragrant) or 'có mùi' (has a smell).
